objective: how come you couldn't price the asbestos soffit removal on our tender? What does that actually cost?

inclusions: Removal and disposal of asbestos-containing soffit material
assumptions: Treating the soffit as asbestos-containing material requiring specialist removal
clarifications: Soffit area, asbestos type and condition, access and height, containment requirements, and disposal arrangements

objective: Our tender flagged liquefaction-prone ground. What does ground improvement cost for a single-storey light commercial building in Christchurch, and how common is this problem?

scope.item: Ground improvement for a single-storey light commercial building on liquefaction-prone ground
inclusions: Ground improvement work required to address liquefaction-related ground conditions
assumptions: Treating this as a request for a ground-improvement rate per unit area, since no building size or total quantity was given.
Scope is limited to ground improvement for a new light commercial building.
clarifications: Ground improvement method and treatment depth
Whether the price should include design, testing, and construction monitoring
Building footprint and site-specific ground conditions
Meaning of “how common” (for example, citywide prevalence or likelihood at this site)

objective: Client wants to know the cost impact of switching the roof from long-run coloursteel to a membrane on a 1200m2 warehouse.

scope.item: Net cost change of a membrane roof in place of long-run Coloursteel
scope.unitText: m² of roof area, net change (membrane roof less the long-run Coloursteel roof it replaces)
inclusions: Membrane roof system in place, including its substrate
Credit for the long-run Coloursteel roofing no longer needed
exclusions: Removal or disposal of existing roofing
assumptions: The 1200 m² refers to roof area
clarifications: State the membrane type and required build-up.
State whether existing roof removal, flashings, gutters, and drainage are included.

scopedBy.amendedBy: operator (Shaun approved pinning the net change, 25 September)
